objectives.statement: Form the present tense of regular verbs by using the -er form.
Recognize that Bokmål present tense uses the same verb form with every subject.
Use the common present-tense forms er, har, and gjør in simple statements.
Interpret present tense as current action, current state, or habit from context.

notes: Must teach the basic Bokmål present-tense form, including common irregulars er, har, and gjør, and simple statements about current habits or states. Norwegian present tense has no weak-verb class split (all weak verbs take -er: snakker/jobber/kjøper), so present formation is uniform; do not teach past-form classes here.
